title.zh: Binance Will Support the Terra (LUNA) Network Upgrade - 2026-09-21
title.en: Binance Will Support the Terra (LUNA) Network Upgrade - 2026-09-21

current_state.zh: Binance announced it will suspend deposits and withdrawals on the Terra (LUNA) network starting around 2026-09-21 14:00 UTC to facilitate a network upgrade.
